note: Duplicate rows confirmed to be one market, left out of the canonical file by build-consolidated-markets.mjs. Each dropped slug must redirect to the survivor in data/slug-redirects.json. See scripts/lib/merged-markets.mjs.

merges.name: Santa Rosa Community Wednesday Farmers Market
merges.reason: Wednesday row of the Santa Rosa Community Farmers Market in the California WIC dataset. Agricultural Community Events runs one market on Wednesdays and Saturdays; merge approved by Kelly Smith (ACE) by email on 2026-11-16.

merges.reason: Second legacy row for the Napa Farmers Market, at its old 500 First St address; napafarmersmarket.org gives one market at 1100 West St. Merge approved by the site owner on 2026-11-16.

merges.name: Georgetown Farmers’ Market
merges.reason: Legacy USDA row for the Rose Park Farmers Market at 2600 O St NW, Washington, DC; Friends of Rose Park runs one Wednesday market at 26th and O St NW. Merge requested by the operator by email, recorded on 2026-11-18. The survivor keeps the operator's organizer access.

merges.name: Georgetown Market IN Rose Park
merges.reason: Second legacy USDA row for the Rose Park Farmers Market (26th and O St NW, Washington, DC), with a placeholder phone and a pin about 4 km east of the park. Merge requested by the operator by email, recorded on 2026-11-18.

merges.name: Grass Valley Farmers Market
merges.reason: California WIC row for the Grass Valley Farmers Market at 650 Freeman Ln (Pine Creek Shopping Center); the market confirmed by email on 2026-11-18 that it is one market with a Saturday and a seasonal Tuesday day. Its WIC authorization moves to the survivor through an editorial override. The survivor keeps the operator's organizer access.

merges.name: Pacific Grove Certified Farmers Market
merges.reason: California WIC row for the Pacific Grove Certified Farmers' Market at Central and Grand Ave; Everyone's Harvest runs one Monday market there. Merge requested by the operator by email, recorded on 2026-11-18. The survivor already lists WIC and keeps the operator's organizer access.

merges.name: Marina Certified Farmers Market
merges.reason: California WIC row for the Marina Certified Farmers' Market at 215 Reservation Rd; Everyone's Harvest runs one Sunday market there. Merge requested by the operator by email, recorded on 2026-11-18. Its WIC authorization moves to the survivor through an editorial override, and the survivor keeps the operator's organizer access.

merges.name: Downtown Slo Farmers Market
merges.reason: California WIC dataset row for the Downtown SLO Thursday Night Farmers’ Market on Higuera St between Chorro and Osos, the same Thursday market as the main listing. Merge requested by Downtown SLO by email, recorded on 2026-11-19. The survivor keeps the operator's organizer access and the WIC flag.

merges.name: Redwood City Kiwanis Farmers Market
merges.reason: Second legacy USDA row for the Redwood City Kiwanis Farmers Market (850 Winslow St), with no hours of its own. Redwood City Kiwanis runs one Saturday market; merge requested by the operator by email, recorded on 2026-11-19. The survivor keeps the operator's organizer access.

merges.name: Kaiser Redwood City Farmers Market
merges.reason: Second legacy USDA row for the Kaiser Permanente Redwood City Farmers’ Market at the old 1150 Veterans Blvd. address, with no hours of its own. West Coast Farmers Markets Association runs one Tuesday market at 1100 Veterans Blvd.; address correction sent by the operator by email on 2026-11-19 and merge approved by the site owner the same day. The survivor keeps the operator's organizer access.
